posts: Profiled my NEAR contract before optimizing: 68% of gas was serde deserialization on a 12KB blob. Switched to borsh + zero-copy reads, cut 3.1 → 1.9 Tgas per call. Numbers first, then the diff ships tomorrow. #rust #near

replies.text: Breakeven math: 1.6% IL against 14% fee APR ≈ 11.4 days to recover, assuming both hold flat. I trigger rebalances at IL > 2× expected daily fee yield — eyeballing chop is how small losses compound.
The roadmap is at least testable now: routed a cross-chain swap through a NEAR function-call key last week, one attestation, ~2s finality. Adoption may track liquidity, but the primitives work today.
